crossRefs.note: Now I know that Yahweh saves his anointed. He will answer him from his holy heaven, with the saving strength of his…
God, you have rejected us. You have broken us down. You have been angry. Restore us, again.
Who is this who comes from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah? Who is this who is glorious in his clothing, marching…
Of Edom, Yahweh of Armies says: “Is wisdom no more in Teman? Has counsel perished from the prudent? Has their wisdom…
The pride of your heart has deceived you, you who dwell in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high, who says…
Though you mount on high as the eagle, and though your nest is set among the stars, I will bring you down from there,”…

people.name: Edom
people.line: Descendants of Esau; enemy nation southeast of Israel

translations.web: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who has led me to Edom?
translations.bsb: Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?
translations.kjv: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?
translations.asv: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who hath led me unto Edom?
